text: hey so there is in the framework regarding text rendering where the cursor follows the text being typed, and well the cursor from it seems doesnt know about a good number of characters so it falls behind when you add a space or some glyphs like {} [] \ and what not

events.text: Root cause confirmed in framework text metrics: caret/scroll/hit-test bypassed node font family and weight, omitted letter spacing, and the hit-test returned the prior byte. Styled glyph-advance unit test is green; ReleaseFast text_vs_input ship passes via isolated Zig cache. Running the required sustained frame-time gate next.

Frame-time gate: 60s text-heavy hidden run baseline ~4.16ms/240fps; text paint stayed 35-68us with no text/atlas/repaint spike class. Detector reported present/native scheduling spikes. An identical 60s empty control reproduced the same present/native ~100-frame spike classes with 2-8us paint, proving they are baseline environment noise rather than a regression from this change.

resolution: The inactive text-cursor fix was swept into the GPU packing commit: cursor advance now follows the same measured glyph/whitespace path as rendered text, with Zig coverage for spaces and punctuation such as braces, brackets, and backslashes.
